description: This is a unit test source file for testing network information iterators and adapters in the WPEFramework project using Google Test framework.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for network adapters, providing methods to iterate over network interfaces.

classes.name: IPV4AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for IPv4 addresses associated with a network adapter.

classes.name: IPV6AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for IPv6 addresses associated with a network adapter.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Class implementing observer pattern for network adapter events.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the network adapter.

methods.name: IPv4Addresses
methods.description: Returns an IPv4AddressIterator for the adapter.

methods.name: IPv6Addresses
methods.description: Returns an IPV6AddressIterator for the adapter.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the count of addresses or interfaces in the iterator.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to its initial state.

methods.name: IsUp
methods.description: Checks if the adapter is operational (up).

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the adapter is running.

methods.name: MACAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the adapter.
